label: A · Conversation workspace
prompt:
Create ONE full-fidelity desktop application UI mockup, landscape 1600 by 1000, straight-on pixel-perfect screenshot appearance. This is a composition proposal for a new WINDOWS Electron + React personal assistant, working name JaxOS. Use the attached actual Hermes Desktop screenshot ONLY as visual reference for its quiet icy blue / white flat desktop material, hairlines, spacious text, compact sidebar and restrained cobalt actions. Do not reproduce Hermes branding, its large wordmark, Mac traffic lights, or its exact content. Use a native-looking Windows top bar with minimize, maximize and close at the top right, simple original small JaxOS mark at top left. Palette: #f8faff background, #f3f7ff sidebar, white primary content, #17171a primary text, #0053fd accent. Readable Segoe UI-style sans typography, consistent thin line icons. No browser address bar, device bezel, photographic scene, gradients, decorative glass, nested cards, giant hero text, or marketing. UI controls must look usable, aligned and finely crafted, with enough negative space. Show visible small 'Concept · sample data' text in the top bar, so illustrative content cannot be mistaken for live activity. Four mode names must be easy to find: Brainstorm, Daily, Build, Test. Sidebar project is 'Blueprint' with honest 'Not connected' indicator and 'Open project' action. Do NOT show successful tests, invented connected repositories, or fabricated completed work. This is a design image, not an actual functioning app.
COMPOSITION A: A chat-first daily working environment. Full-height 220px left navigation sidebar, broad 980px center conversation, quiet 300px right project-context pane. Main conversation is the dominant focal area; keep right pane subordinate. Sidebar has New conversation button, Today, Projects, Memory, Skills, and recent session rows 'Personal desktop assistant', 'Ideas for the week', 'Project notes'. At the top of central content, title 'Personal desktop assistant' and compact four-mode segmented switch with Brainstorm selected. Conversation contains a user message 'Help me shape a desktop assistant for my everyday work.' and assistant response with heading 'One place to think, build, and verify.' followed by readable short text 'Keep four modes, one project memory, and a clear path from an idea to tested work.' Then a flat numbered list 'Explore the idea', 'Define a small first milestone', 'Build it and check the result'. A text action 'Turn this into a brief' under the response. No large decorative card. Bottom composer is substantial and anchored, placeholder 'What would you like to work on?', attachment icon, a model selection control and cobalt arrow send button, with subtle keyboard hint. Right pane title 'Working context' tabs 'Brief' and 'Decisions', project Blueprint / Not connected, small Open project action, proposed goal 'A personal assistant for Windows', proposed checks with empty checkboxes 'Remember the conversation', 'Open a local project', 'Keep test evidence'. Bottom muted text 'No checks run'. There is a calm horizontal status footer. All text must be crisp and accurate, no lorem ipsum. Render the entire application window with its four edges visible.
approval: User approved proposed Windows MVP and combination of conversation shell with Build/Test workbench on 2026-10-11.
